question: Does repaired deterministic block allocation remain balanced on independent seed windows not used to tune the initial whitening transformation?
comparator: Original pre-repair LCG; both share same deterministic blocks and full per-block balance requirement
endpoints: every n=4 block has exactly one arm each
maximum relative deviation from expected 1024 of each arm in each position per holdout window <=0.12
24-permutation histogram counts, min/max/chi-square descriptive only, no p-value confirmation after tuning
n=8 and n=10000 at seed 0, 4294967295 retains exact 4-arm balance
repeated invocation same seed returns same sequence and frozen array
reject invalid seed (-1, 2^32, NaN) and invalid n (0,5,10001)
decision_rule: PASS if all invariants and three max deviation tests pass; otherwise FAIL, preserve failure and request repair, no promotion to secure randomization.
prior_selection_exposure: Original seed window 0..4095 was used to choose and validate 32-bit avalanche; cannot reuse for external confirmation.
assumptions: LCG and 32-bit hash are noncryptographic; tests do not validate human random assignment, unbiasedness under all seeds or concealment
R5: Do not consume two legacy AB-H slots for repair alone; no novel human evidence
